title: Puyo Puyo Sun for SegaNet
overview:
That Puyo Puyo Sun can now be played online!

And please check out Sega Saturn Puyo Puyo Sun too! Compile Club now recruiting members!! (For details, take a look inside the instruction manual!)

The long-awaited third installment!

He's here!? Its name is the red-hot Sun Puyo!

This edition of Puyo Puyo Sun is made for two-player battles over SegaNet. Stack the falling Puyo, pop groups of the same color and string pops into chains to bury your rival in garbage Puyo. New Sun Puyo boost the damage your attacks deal, so matches turn quickly and reward fast counterattacks.

The battles are played online, so an opponent on the network is required.

- 2-player online battles over SegaNet (X-BAND)
- Sun Puyo that power up your attacks
- Requires the Sega Saturn Modem and Sega Saturn Media Card
- Memory backup support

あのぷよSUNが、ネットで遊べる！

セガサターンぷよぷよSUNもよろしくね！
コンパイルクラブ会員募集中!!
(詳しくは、取扱説明書の中を見てね～っ！)

待ってましたの第三弾！

ヤツがやってきた!?
その名もあつ～い太陽ぷよ！
